updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now provides enhanced audit logging for permission checks when users access the portal, offering clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions. This helps administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role enables granular, least-privilege access to device onboarding settings in Endpoint DLP, eliminating the need for broad administrative roles like Compliance Administrator or Global Administrator. This allows auditors and security analysts to view device status without granting excessive permissions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft is increasing maximum auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive. This enhancement enables organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Administrators can now view detailed coverage reports for each enforced auto-labeling policy, showing volumes of labeled and unlabeled files and comparing enforcement progress against simulation snapshots. This visibility helps admins identify coverage gaps and understand labeling effectiveness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics experience helps users understand why DLP policies behaved unexpectedly by showing which policies triggered, evaluation order, and detailed condition insights. E5 customers also receive Copilot-powered recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: New AI-powered visibility tools help administrators track DLP policy deployment and sync status across devices, proactively identifying unhealthy devices and providing root-cause analysis with recommended remediation actions. This accelerates diagnosis and resolution of policy deployment issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management now includes readiness assessment and data explorer experiences to help security teams evaluate data readiness for Copilot, assess sensitive data exposure, and prioritize remediation efforts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft is expanding auto-labeling support for larger SharePoint scopes, improving policy management flexibility, and providing richer visibility into auto-labeling activity across the organization. These enhancements help manage labeling policies at enterprise scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previously enforced 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP can now monitor sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and apply restrictive actions based on organizational requirements. Administrators can configure FTP and SFTP transfer activities in their Endpoint DLP policies.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows improper certificate validation, permitting an authorized attacker to bypass a security feature over the network. Organizations should apply the latest security updates to protect their PKI infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector exposes sensitive information to unauthorized actors, allowing an authorized attacker to disclose information locally. Administrators should update Entra connectors to the latest version.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109455: Microsoft Office SharePoint Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over the network. Administrators should apply the latest SharePoint updates to close this authorization gap.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary code over a network. Organizations using Azure DevOps Server should apply security updates immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM has been identified affecting multiple Microsoft products including Office software. Organizations should update affected software to prevent potential authentication spoofing attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62903: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability via capture-replay in SQL Server allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over the network. Applications using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient should be updated to the patched version.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105588: Windows DHCP Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Windows DHCP Server allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. Organizations should apply the security update to prevent privilege escalation.
